prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: technical drawing. Texture family: aged vellum grain with restrained oxidized-bronze patina speckling. Palette: deep Aegean blue and charcoal foundations, parchment cream, oxidized copper verdigris, muted antique bronze and ochre, with sparse pale celestial-blue highlights. Line treatment: precise compass-and-stylus technical linework for gears, pointers and orbital geometry, softened by fine archaeological engraving hatching and occasional worn or broken edges. Lighting: cool raking archaeological light with restrained warm bronze glints and soft shadow falloff. Avoid: no photorealism, no glossy 3D CGI, no steampunk, no cyberpunk or neon sci-fi, no anime, no modern blueprint grids or CAD UI, no holograms, no glowing digital numerals, no modern watches or computers, no pristine fantasy machinery, and no readable generated text anywhere in the artwork. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism.
